name: comp-578

frames.best_why: The Features mega menu is open with three labelled entries and their descriptions.

tagline: A slim top bar whose nav items drop rich panels of links underneath.
summary: A dark site header with a logo, four nav items, and Sign In plus a Get Started button; Features, Pricing and About each open a dropdown panel of links, some with descriptions or icons.
appearance: A full-width dark header bar with a starburst logo at the left, then Home, Features, Pricing and About each with a small chevron, and Sign In plus a white Get Started pill at the right. A thin border runs along the bottom.
behaviour: Opening a chevron item shows a rounded panel beneath it: Features lists three entries with descriptions, Pricing four products, About three icon rows. Moving to another trigger swaps the panel, and below the md breakpoint the menu folds into a hamburger popover.
demo_content: Nav reads Home, Features, Pricing, About; panels name components, docs, templates and products A-D.
search_phrases: header with sign in and get started
use_when: A marketing site needs a top bar whose sections reveal rich dropdown panels.
avoid_when: Submenus hide below the md breakpoint; mobile only gets a flat popover list without descriptions or icons.
customise: Menu labels, links, descriptions, icons and the right-side buttons are all written inside the file; colours follow theme tokens.
weight_why: A few links and one dropdown panel open at a time.

a11y.note: The logo link has no accessible name, and the menu slide has no reduced-motion handling.

polish_why: Three dropdown styles handled cleanly with even spacing; the logo has no wordmark.
